note: Features whose Playwright spec exists but cannot yet cover the whole §16.2 scenario. Each entry says what is pending and which task owns it. features.pending: 'chưa xác thực thì không mua được gói' through the checkout SCREEN: POST /api/orders already refuses an unverified learner (F39 asserts urn:e9x:problem:email-not-verified at the real endpoint, OrderServiceIT.unverifiedEmailCannotOrder), but there is no plan/checkout page yet, so the browser scenario (open a plan, try to pay, get refused, verify, the same order goes through) is pending.

Done through the real stack (P2.6): the author builds a TOEIC test on the screen part by part from published question groups, the screen checks it against the exam (a count that differs warns, a missing skill blocks the review), the number of resumes is set per test, the test is published only by a review that waits for its groups (a draft group refuses the approval), and an edit makes version 2 while version 1 stays PUBLISHED (the review is run by seed.reviewVersion, the real ReviewService, until the review screens exist). Pending: 'gắn bảng quy đổi ghi đè' on a screen (the TEST scope is enabled in the database since V202611120002 and resolve uses it, covered by TestVersionViewIT.publishingVersion2OfATestKeepsTheOverride and db-test 44; no CMS screen or endpoint writes the override yet: its header is the administrator's, its rows are versioned content), and the full-size tests 'TOEIC 200 câu' / 'IELTS 4 kỹ năng' with every count right (they need ~100 published questions: the Excel import of P2.7 makes them).
features.owner: P2.7 (import: full-size tests), the override screen (an administrator's)

features.pending: Done through the real stack (P2.5): the author makes the DEFAULT table of an exam skill on the screen, the server refuses a gap in the raw values and a score that falls (TableConverter), the table is published only by a review (seed.reviewVersion, the real ReviewService, until the review screens exist), an edit makes version 2 and the published version is untouched, version 1 is archived when 2 is published. Pending: 'ghi đè' on the screen (since P2.6 the database accepts a TEST-scope table for a real test, written by the administrator of the test's owner only, and ScoreTables#resolve uses it for every version of the test; the score-table CMS still answers 409 for scope TEST and no screen sets an override: see the F13 entry), and 'kết quả thi dùng đúng bảng; sửa bảng không đổi kết quả cũ' (an exam result records the score table version it used: no results exist yet).
features.owner: the override screen (an administrator's, with the F13 entry), P4.1 (results use and record the table version)

features.pending: Done through the real stack (P2.5): the author writes the IELTS Writing Task 2 skill on the screen (rubric, criteria, prompt template with the four variables, scored samples, result schema that must declare every criterion), a review publishes it, a teacher of the exam reads the published one and a learner never does, an edit makes version 2.
